v25_cue_dedicated.description: Cues on the dedicated server: action bar with sound, then a long-label title that must fit on screen. The owner reports what appeared.
commands: devtool checkpoint cue V25_ACTIONBAR actionbar sound

v25_arm_then_disconnect.description: Arms a checkpoint with a long timeout. The card then disconnects the client. Expect AWAIT outcome=cancelled reason=operatorLost or the bundle ending with senderLost=true, never a timeout.

v25_await_then_change_dimension.description: Waits on a far region with a long timeout. The card then moves the player to the Nether with /forge setdim. Expect AWAIT outcome=cancelled reason=dimensionChanged and the bundle halting.

v25_nether_pig.description: Run while standing in the Nether: summons a pig there and writes its NBT by selector so the UUID is in the log. The card then returns to the overworld and looks the pig up by UUID from there; expect dimension=-1 on that record.

v25_cleanup.description: Stops the session. The Nether pig is left; it is harmless and far away.
